data.professional_title: Delivery Manager | PMO | Digital Transformation | Banking & Fintech
data.summary: PMP-certified Delivery / Program Manager with 9+ years of experience in program governance, enterprise delivery, and transformation programs across Banking, Fintech, and Insurance domains. Expertise in managing digital platforms, Agile delivery, portfolio management, risk and compliance, and stakeholder engagement. Proven ability to lead multimillion-dollar programs ($60M+), drive AI- enabled automation, and deliver scalable, high-impact business solutions.

responsibilities: Led end-to-end delivery of enterprise digital banking, fintech, and mobile transformation programs valued at $60M+.
Directed multiple cross-functional teams across Product, Engineering, QA, Design, Analytics, with ownership of delivery governance.

experience.role: Established PMO frameworks including RAID logs, milestone tracking, budget controls, capacity planning, & executive dashboards.
responsibilities: Partnered with VP / MD / CXO to define strategic roadmaps, priorities, risks, and transformation initiatives.
Delivered digital banking capabilities including onboarding, payments, fund transfers, card servicing, and self-service journeys.
Implemented AI-enabled OCR automation reducing manual processing effort by 30% and improving turnaround time.
Improved delivery predictability through Agile governance, sprint metrics, and release planning.
Presented weekly steering committee updates with KPIs, risks, blockers, and budget status.
Led execution of strategic roadmap for core banking modernization, API integration, and payment transformation programs.
Optimized Agile delivery teams across development, QA, business analysis, and production support functions.
Built PMO governance models using JIRA and Confluence for project planning, risk management, and executive reporting.
Delivered digital customer experience initiatives across web and mobile channels.
Implemented Adobe Analytics / Google Analytics dashboards improving funnel conversion by 25%.
Mentored team leads and engineers to improve execution quality and accountability. Mumbai, IN
Developed and deployed hybrid mobile applications for enterprise telecom client projects.
Managed integration of third-party Single Sign-On (SSO) platforms reducing development effort by 20%.
Supported release management, UAT, defect resolution, and production deployments.

raw_sections.awards:
KEY ACHIEVEMENTS
Delivered 15+ enterprise programs with budgets up to $60M across banking and fintech domains • Reduced manual processing effort by 30% through AI-enabled OCR automation • Improved digital funnel conversion by 25% using analytics-driven optimization • Enhanced delivery predictability through Agile governance and release planning frameworks 
AWARDS Gem of Analytics | Excellent Performer | Top Performer of the Team | Outstanding Dependability
raw_sections.skills:
CORE COMPETENCIES
Program & Portfolio Leadership: Program Management, Execution Governance, Budget Ownership Agile & Delivery Excellence: Agile/Scrum, Release Management, Sprint Planning, Delivery Assurance Banking & Payments: Digital Banking, Payment Platforms, Core Banking Modernization, Fintech Solutions Stakeholder & Governance: Executive Reporting, RAID Management, Vendor Governance, Risk & Compliance Data & Automation: AI Enablement, OCR Automation, Analytics, KPI/OKR Tracking
TECHNICAL SKILLS Governance Tools: JIRA, Confluence, Smartsheet, SharePoint, Microsoft Project, MS Visio Delivery Platforms: Azure DevOps, GitHub, UAT Platforms, CMS Platforms, Swagger Reporting Tools: Excel, PowerPoint, Power BI, Google Sheets, Adobe Analytics Cloud Exposure: AWS, Azure, SaaS Platforms Data / AI Exposure: Python, SQL, OCR Solutions, Prompt Engineering, GenAI Methodologies: Agile, Scrum, Waterfall, UAT, Release Management
raw_sections.experience:
PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE Associate Delivery Manager
Nov '20 - Present
Bounteous x Accolite
Gurugram, India
Led end-to-end delivery of enterprise digital banking, fintech, and mobile transformation programs valued at $60M+. • Directed multiple cross-functional teams across Product, Engineering, QA, Design, Analytics, with ownership of delivery governance. • Established PMO frameworks including RAID logs, milestone tracking, budget controls, capacity planning, & executive dashboards. • Partnered with VP / MD / CXO to define strategic roadmaps, priorities, risks, and transformation initiatives. • Delivered digital banking capabilities including onboarding, payments, fund transfers, card servicing, and self-service journeys. • Implemented AI-enabled OCR automation reducing manual processing effort by 30% and improving turnaround time. • Improved delivery predictability through Agile governance, sprint metrics, and release planning. • Presented weekly steering committee updates with KPIs, risks, blockers, and budget status. Mumbai, IN
Consultant
Feb '19  -  Nov '20
Infrasoft Technologies
Led execution of strategic roadmap for core banking modernization, API integration, and payment transformation programs. • Optimized Agile delivery teams across development, QA, business analysis, and production support functions. • Built PMO governance models using JIRA and Confluence for project planning, risk management, and executive reporting. • Delivered digital customer experience initiatives across web and mobile channels. • Implemented Adobe Analytics / Google Analytics dashboards improving funnel conversion by 25%. • Coordinated business stakeholders, compliance teams, and technology teams to ensure timely deployment. • Mentored team leads and engineers to improve execution quality and accountability. Mumbai, IN
Software Engineer
Aug '16  -  Oct '18
Tech Mahindra
Developed and deployed hybrid mobile applications for enterprise telecom client projects. • Managed integration of third-party Single Sign-On (SSO) platforms reducing development effort by 20%. • Supported release management, UAT, defect resolution, and production deployments.
raw_sections.projects:
PROJECTS Qatar Islamic Bank (UK) – Digital Banking Transformation (Qatar Islamic Bank) Role: Delivery Manager
Delivered onboarding, payments, cheque processing capabilities. • Directed card management including activation, PIN reset, limits, replacement, and controls. • Coordinated vendors, engineering teams, compliance, and business stakeholders. • Implemented fraud detection and OCR cheque deposit solutions. • Improved release planning and delivery predictability through Agile governance frameworks. • Led delivery of mobile and internet banking platform. White Label Application (WLA) Payments & Wallet Platform (Marqeta)
Role: Associate Delivery Manager
Delivered real-time wallet, payments, KYC, and card management platform. • Integrated Visa / Mastercard and third-party payment gateways. • Controlled sprint execution, UAT, release planning, and go-live readiness. • Liaised with cross-functional teams across Product, Engineering, QA, Risk, and Operations.
Suncanvas-Insurance Platform Modernization (Sun Life) Role: Project Manager • Supervised digital onboarding, premium payments, and policy servicing platform. • Implemented Adobe Analytics / Google Analytics dashboards improving journeys across mobile and web channels conversion by 25%. • Administered roadmap execution, governance reviews, risks, and budgets. • Improved mobile and web customer journeys through UX enhancements.
